decisions.decision: JUCE UMP MIDI 2.0 issue identified but not fixed
decisions.rationale: JUCE unconditionally sets SND_SEQ_CLIENT_UMP_MIDI_2_0 on Linux (juce_Midi_linux.cpp:547), preventing MIDI from Legacy devices. Temporary diagnostic patch to SND_SEQ_CLIENT_LEGACY_MIDI proved the connection works. Proper fix deferred — needs to support both protocols.

context_notes: v1.8 shipped. All milestone artifacts archived. Git tagged v1.8. REQUIREMENTS.md removed (fresh for next milestone). Roland J-6 USB MIDI doesn't work on Linux (kernel driver issue: 'quirk or no altset; falling back to MIDI 1.0' — device sends zero bytes at raw USB level). MIDI code verified working via ALSA sequencer software path. Deferred ideas list has SPU hardware features (PMON, NON, volume sweep, signed volume) as natural v1.9 candidates. Also: Bit Corrupt effect, codec re-sync, ratio drift experiments.
